name: Lead Reclaim & Rubber Products Ltd.
summary: Lead Reclaim & Rubber Products Ltd. is an India-based company engaged in the manufacturing and recycling of rubber products. The company primarily produces reclaimed rubber, crumb rubber powder, and rubber granules, including whole tire reclaim rubber, butyl reclaim rubber, and natural reclaim rubber. These products are derived from recycled scrap rubber, emphasizing sustainability and environmental responsibility. The company serves a diverse range of industries, including the tire, automotive, construction, footwear, conveyor belt, tube, and agriculture products sectors. Its target markets include OEMs, Tier I companies, distributors, and dealers, both domestically and internationally. The company's manufacturing operations are located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and it has recently expanded its production capacity.
